_note: Counts how many speakers a turn plans and how many of them actually speak, over three consecutive inputs against Ireti Okan. The speaker count per turn is a local weighted roll (one speaker 60%, two 25%, three 15%), so a session that answers with a single character every time is either rolling ones or losing planned lines to validation - and the [turn] line in the Godot log reports both numbers, which tells the two apart. None of the three messages names a cast member, because naming one makes that character the priority speaker and forces a single-speaker turn by design. Costs a director call and one actor call per planned speaker, three times over, so run it deliberately. Model is whichever the session's Settings select; a slow one needs the per-message wait raised.
